claim: On macOS, the current source- and executable-bound R-SURFACE-006 Tiles route operates the real inventory selector by advertised item UID, preserving exact selector receipts and fail-closing an invalid stable target.
material_proof: One selected current-bound r_surface_006.inventory_selector_tiles run observes the native inventory descriptor, resolves the distinct live rock and plastic-bottle UIDs from advertised actions, performs filter/reset and details or contents through those UIDs, exercises one permitted derived selector operation, observes the resulting nested owner or explicit unsupported child, records exact accepted receipts, rejects an invalid or stale UID without retargeting, and accepts cleanup. Fixture manufacture has zero feature credit.
material_contradiction: an item action is delivered by invlet, row, label, coordinate, physical input, OCR, or direct state mutation instead of its advertised UID
the selector accepts an invalid, stale, moved, destroyed, inaccessible, or wrong-selector UID by retargeting another item
a child owner exposes inherited inventory or world actions, or an unsupported child exposes executable actions
an accepted receipt names a different consuming selector frame, source/runtime binding drifts, or cleanup fails
already_accepted_evidence: The current focused selector tests cover the shared UID adapter, distinct non-aggregated child items, controls, and stale-target rejection.
The r_surface_006 fixture is a disposable zero-credit bootstrap whose items must be rediscovered from the live native descriptor.
current_uncertainty: No selected source-bound Tiles witness has yet independently exercised the live selector route, its derived operation and nested ownership, its exact receipts, and its fail-closed stable-target control together.
forbidden_shortcuts: raw keys, invlets, rows, labels as identity, physical keyboard or mouse, focus, OCR, screen coordinates, or direct state mutation
treating the charter, fixture installation, startup, screenshots, source tests, or a prior report as production proof
claiming coverage for unobserved selector families or gameplay credit from this zero-credit route
honest_stop_conditions: stop before launch if the registry cannot select the current executable, scenario, fixture, and chartered route
after launch, stop and report a missing/stale receipt, binding drift, forbidden dispatch, retargeting, invalid child action set, or cleanup contradiction
seal and finish when the live route has settled the advertised UID operations, nested ownership, exact receipt, and invalid-target control
